critical_paths.name: Browser app bootstrap and global runtime capture
critical_paths.notes: src/main.jsx initializes the SDK; the SDK owns global error and rejection capture, while the app retains console visibility.

critical_paths.name: Client routing and auth callback flow
critical_paths.notes: Path-based routing, including /auth/callback handling, is owned by the SPA hooks and App shell.

critical_paths.name: Google Drive and Dropbox sync auth and session lifecycle
critical_paths.notes: Browser auth and direct provider transport live under src/hooks and src/stores/yjs/providers. The shared Worker control plane is private infrastructure; routine file operations go directly to the provider.

critical_paths.name: Production build and Pages deployment pipeline
critical_paths.notes: Core builds dist-app independently from the Astro public site. Production browser tokens are injected into the app artifact at build time.

debugbundle.notes: Core app profile only. The Astro public site and shared Worker are independent private repositories with separate DebugBundle projects and release authority.
